objective: Corregir exclusivamente la compilacion del workflow Gate6 E2E moviendo runner.temp al step runtime, disparar un nuevo run con marker R4 e imprimir evidence.json para certificar cleanup residue=0. No alterar el harness funcional ni Produccion.

actions.content:
name: Catalogo Ampliado Gate6 E2E Development
on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths:
      - ops/e2e/requests/CATALOGO-AMPLIADO-GATE6-R4-20260908.execute
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: 54.39.104.176
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: 1433
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: EDARSAHUB
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
      JWT_SECRET: gate6-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.sha }}
      ENV: development
      CATALOGO_GATE6_REAL: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install backend runtime
        run: python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
      - name: Navigation and frontend build
        run: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && grep -q 'path="catalogo-ampliado"' frontend/src/App.js && grep -q 'CatalogoAmpliadoDashboard' frontend/src/App.js
      - name: Real API SQL E2E
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/backend
          GATE6_EVIDENCE_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/gate6/evidence.json
        run: mkdir -p $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6 && python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_catalogo_ampliado_gate6_e2e_real.py
      - name: Evidence summary
        if: always()
        run: test -f $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6/evidence.json && cat $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6/evidence.json || true
      - name: Manifest
        if: always()
        run: mkdir -p $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6 && printf '%s\n' run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID commit=$GITHUB_SHA production_touched=false > $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6/manifest.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: catalogo-ampliado-gate6-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gate6
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
